card.architecture: XDoG line extraction + dilate + multiply composite (no model) — XDoGLines + LineThicken (ComfyUI-PixelHarness)
card.summary: Outline-only thicken: eXtended Difference-of-Gaussians pulls the existing edges out, the line layer is boldened, and it's multiplied back over the source so flat-colour interiors stay clean. No model, no VRAM. Avoids the interior-muddying of a plain erode.
use_cases: thicken ONLY the outlines, preserving flat fills
card.pick_when: You want only the outlines boldened, leaving interior flat colour untouched.
